entries.title: Start here: two patients, two leads
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: Verify two-team staffing, transfer acceptance pathways and clinician availability against each site; no staff availability can be inferred from checklist.

entries.title: Precipitous vaginal delivery
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: Compare nuchal-cord handling, oxytocin prophylaxis, delayed cord clamping, placenta management and escalation against local OB protocol; high-risk procedures require supervised training.

entries.title: Newborn resuscitation
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: AHA 2025 confirms early ventilation for apnea/gasping or persistent HR <100. HR response alone must never stop ventilation when breathing remains inadequate.

entries.title: Newborn ventilation
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: AHA 2025 supports ventilation 30–60/min and pressure titration to effectiveness; training must include leak/obstruction troubleshooting and avoidance of excessive pressure.

entries.title: Newborn advanced airway
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: Check ETT sizing/depth rules and SGA gestational-age applicability against current primary guideline and stocked devices; no universal device rule.

entries.title: Emergency umbilical venous access
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: High-risk sterile procedure and emergency line placement: confirm catheter depth, access precautions, flush and local kit independently.

entries.title: Newborn epinephrine doses
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: High-risk neonatal epinephrine table and ETT route: independent neonatal pharmacist + NRP instructor concentration/dose/flush/route verification required; doses left unchanged.

entries.title: Newborn fluids and glucose
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: High-risk fluids, dextrose, glucose rechecks and post-resuscitation feeding/transport require neonatal specialist/pharmacy review; dose content left unchanged.

entries.title: Shoulder dystocia
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: RCOG 2026 confirms emergency maneuvers require practical skills training. Avoid treating anatomical figures as an authorized procedural sequence; no fundal pressure.

entries.title: Umbilical cord prolapse
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
primary_sources_to_reconcile: RCOG cord prolapse (older guideline; update check required)
entries.finding: Cord elevation and immediate obstetric resolution require site-specific capability check; RCOG cord-prolapse reference is older and update checking is needed.

entries.title: Unexpected breech delivery
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
primary_sources_to_reconcile: institutional OB emergency policy; senior obstetric specialist
entries.finding: Unexpected breech delivery involves advanced, low-frequency maneuvers: do not use text-only guidance as procedural competency; seek live expert support and hands-on training.

entries.title: Postpartum hemorrhage
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: WHO 2025: ≥500 mL, or ≥300 mL plus abnormal hemodynamic sign. Clinical concern and ongoing bleeding override numeric thresholds.

entries.title: Maternal hemorrhage medications
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: Oxytocin/TXA/second-line uterotonic doses and contraindications require direct pharmacy and OB verification; dosing unchanged in this pass.

entries.title: Inversion, retained placenta and tears
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: Inversion, retained placenta and traumatic bleeding require trained procedural rescue, urgent OB/surgical escalation; do not allow text to substitute training.

entries.title: Eclampsia: seizures and magnesium
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: High-risk magnesium regimens, toxicity response, renal adjustment and BP thresholds require institutional OB/pharmacy sign-off.

entries.title: Severe hypertension in pregnancy
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: Severe persistent BP threshold and treatment timing need confirmation against current ACOG/SMFM and facility-approved drug protocol.

entries.title: Maternal arrest: resuscitative delivery
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: AHA 2025 confirms manual left uterine displacement, prep at arrest recognition and aim for delivery by 5 minutes if no ROSC; procedural skills review pending.

entries.title: After birth and after resuscitation
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: Neonatal monitoring and HIE referral/cooling criteria must be reconciled with accepting neonatal service; avoid delaying transfer.

entries.title: Newborn prophylaxis and handoff
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: HIGH-RISK SOURCE DIVERGENCE: CDC changed recommendations Dec 2025 for HBsAg-negative mothers; AAP still favors universal birth dose. Follow local policy, parent discussion, and urgent positive/unknown-status prophylaxis.

entries.title: Adult tube thoracostomy
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: Check side/site landmarks, sedation/local anesthetic maxima, pleural safety and tube management; do not blindly disrupt adhesions.

entries.title: Adult Seldinger pigtail
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: Drain indication, pleural ultrasound, kit-specific dilator use and local escalation need procedural review.

entries.title: Chest drain problems
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: Occlusion, disconnection, excessive drainage and clinical deterioration require local troubleshooting protocol; drain troubleshooting is not a substitute for resuscitation.

entries.title: Adult emergency cricothyrotomy
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: DAS 2025 supports vertical skin incision as default when membrane landmarks uncertain; FONA competency, equipment and governance require local sign-off.

entries.title: Before covering an ED without OB
entries.status: AI triage complete · independent clinical verification pending
entries.finding: Check facility resources on every shift; profile checkmarks do not verify real-time stock, transfer availability or responder capability.
